{"sql": "WITH q AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN '2018-Q1'
              WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN '2018-Q2' END AS quarter
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
    AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
),
item AS (
  SELECT q.quarter, sum(i.price) AS gmv
  FROM q JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  GROUP BY q.quarter
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT q.quarter, count(DISTINCT q.order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM q GROUP BY q.quarter
)
SELECT item.quarter, item.gmv, cnt.order_cnt
FROM item JOIN cnt USING(quarter)
ORDER BY item.quarter;"}

口径说明与审核意见处理：
1. 已按知识定义修正口径：GMV = SUM(order_items.price)，不含运费，排除 canceled/unavailable；不再使用 SUM(payment_value)。
